items.good: Heavy traffic made me late for the interview.

Heavy traffic did me late for the interview.
Heavy traffic made me lately for the interview.

items.rule: '교통 체증'은 heavy traffic처럼 heavy와 함께 써요. strong, hard, tall은 traffic과 짝이 되지 않아요.

items.good: Her speech made a deep impression on the audience.

items.good: Anyone who skips the safety check runs a serious risk.

Our team is determine to win the final match.

items.good: The two countries reached an agreement after days of talks.

items.q: "When I apologized, she gave me the cold shoulder." What did she do?
items.why: give someone the cold shoulder는 '일부러 냉랭하게 무시하다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: "My brother has a sweet tooth; he eats candy after every meal." What does "has a sweet tooth" mean?
items.why: have a sweet tooth는 '단것을 매우 좋아하다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: "He got the job because his uncle pulled strings for him." What does "pulled strings" mean?
o: used his influence to help him
paid the company a large fee
wrote a long letter of thanks
items.why: pull strings는 연줄이나 영향력을 이용해 도와주다라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: "After the manager left, the restaurant began to go downhill." What happened to the restaurant?
items.why: go downhill은 '악화되다, 내리막길을 걷다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: "The new nurse needs a week to learn the ropes." What does "learn the ropes" mean?
o: learn how a job is done
items.why: learn the ropes는 '일의 요령을 익히다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: "Let's get the ball rolling by choosing a team leader." What does "get the ball rolling" mean?
items.why: get the ball rolling은 '(일을) 시작하다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: "His speech gave us a lot of food for thought." What does "food for thought" mean?
items.why: food for thought는 곰곰이 생각해 볼 만한 거리를 뜻해요.

items.q: "The shop became famous by word of mouth." How did the shop become famous?
items.why: word of mouth는 입소문을 뜻해요.

items.q: "The two leaders searched for common ground." What were they looking for?
items.why: common ground는 서로 의견이 일치하는 부분이나 공통점을 뜻해요.

items.q: "Off the top of my head, I'd say about fifty people came." What does "off the top of my head" mean?
o: with a hat on my head
items.why: off the top of one's head는 '정확히 확인하지 않고 즉석에서'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: "Winning the lottery is a long shot." What does "a long shot" mean?
items.why: a long shot은 성공할 가능성이 낮은 시도를 뜻해요.

items.q:
Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
The city plans to ___ the problem of traffic jams by building more bus lanes.
items.why: tackle a problem은 '문제를 해결하려고 달려들다'라는 뜻의 짝이에요.

items.q:
Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
The new study may shed ___ on why bees are disappearing.
items.why: shed light on은 '~을 밝히다, 설명해 주다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q:
Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
Students can gain ___ to the library's online books with their ID card.
items.why: gain access to는 '~을 이용할 수 있게 되다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q:
Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
Farmers who plant trees now will ___ the benefits for decades.
items.why: reap the benefits는 '이익을 거두다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q:
Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
Bright colors are used on warning signs to ___ attention to danger.
items.why: draw attention to는 '~로 주의를 끌다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q:
Choose the word that best completes the sentence.
Anna took the ___ and organized the cleanup herself.
items.why: take the initiative는 '솔선해서 나서다'라는 뜻이에요.
